title: How much does it cost to rent a factory or office in Puchong in 2026?
question: How much is the rent for a factory or office in Puchong?
answer: It depends mainly on size, building type and title. Jared Wong's current listings show a 2,000 sq ft mainroad office in Bandar Puteri Puchong at RM1,600 a month (about RM0.80 per sq ft) and an 11,000 sq ft freehold detached factory in Kinrara Industrial Park at RM18,000 a month (about RM1.64 per sq ft of built-up). From 1 January 2026, rental of commercial property in Malaysia is subject to 6% service tax unless an exemption applies.

sections.heading: Real rental examples from Jared's listings (November 2026)
body: Office: 2,000 sq ft, mainroad frontage, partially fitted, individual title, Bandar Puteri Puchong 1 & 2 – RM1,600 per month, which works out to roughly RM0.80 per sq ft.

Detached factory: 11,000 sq ft built-up on 9,600 sq ft of land, freehold, facing the main road, individual title, Kinrara Industrial Park (Bandar Kinrara Seksyen 1) – RM18,000 per month, roughly RM1.64 per sq ft of built-up area.
These are asking rents for specific units. Two units of the same size can rent very differently because of the factors below, so treat per-square-foot figures as a starting point, not a rule.

sections.heading: What pushes rent up or down
body: Building type: detached and semi-detached factories usually ask more per square foot than terrace factories because of better access, compound space and loading.
Frontage and visibility: mainroad-facing units cost more than inner lots, for offices and shops as well as factories.
Power supply, ceiling height and loading access: a factory with the electricity capacity, height and truck access an operator needs commands a premium, while a cheaper unit may need costly upgrades.
Fit-out: partially fitted offices save tenants renovation cost and time.
Title: freehold and individual-title properties are generally easier for owners to finance and for tenants to get approvals on.

sections.heading: Service tax on commercial rent
body: Malaysia brought rental and leasing services into the service tax net from 1 July 2025 at 8%. From 1 January 2026 the rate for rental or leasing services was reduced to 6%.

The government also raised the annual sales threshold for the micro, small and medium enterprise exemption on rental services from RM1 million to RM1.5 million. Whether tax applies depends on the landlord's and tenant's circumstances, so confirm with your tax adviser before signing.

faqs.q: Is rent for a factory in Puchong charged per square foot?
faqs.a: Listings are usually quoted as a monthly rent for the whole unit. Dividing by the built-up area gives a per-square-foot figure that helps compare units, e.g. RM18,000 for 11,000 sq ft is about RM1.64 per sq ft.

faqs.q: Do I pay service tax on commercial rent in Malaysia?
faqs.a: Rental of commercial property has been subject to service tax since 1 July 2025. The rate is 6% from 1 January 2026, and smaller businesses below the RM1.5 million annual sales threshold may be exempt. Check with a tax adviser for your case.

faqs.q: Who can help me find a factory or office to rent in Puchong?
faqs.a: Jared Wong (REN 07483), a commercial and industrial property specialist in Puchong. WhatsApp 012-297 1898 with your preferred area, size, power needs and budget.
